notes.title: The full version of Darkchaser: Battletide is released!
notes.notes:
Adventurers, the full version of Darkchaser: Battletide was officially released on December 5, 2024, at 18:00 PST. Thank you for your play and support since the early access! Players who already own the EA version of Darkchaser: Battletide do not need to purchase again, just update to experience the full version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/b5977579f981a40676bcd9f971f1be762983ce4b.png[/img]
Play as a hero in a monster-infested world, using various skills and relics to arm yourself and battle countless enemies. Join online battles, challenge other players, and grow stronger through levels!

[b]※The full version update includes:[/b]
1. New PvE gameplay: Arcane mode
2. New skill enhancements for Arcane mode
3. New achievements for Arcane mode
4. New Arcane mode gallery
5. Adjusted shop item effects in Arcane mode, differing from standard PvE mode
6. Fixed several combat-related bugs

[b][About Game Price][/b]
The full version of Darkchaser: Battletide will be priced at $4.49 this month. We will have a launch sale from December 5 to December 18, 2024, PST, with the price reduced to $3.37.
Please note:
Due to the development and improvement of game content, the price of the full version of Darkchaser: Battletide will be adjusted on January 1, 2025, from $4.49 to $4.99, and there will be $5.49 in USA due to the tax. 
Don't forget to purchase the game before then!
[b]
The full version includes:[/b]
-13 characters with unique talents
-Three different game modes
-250+ relics with different effects
-50+ skills
-25+ monsters with different styles
-Three selectable difficulty levels
-And Arcane mode - Boosted Skill, Random Talents!（This mode will be continuously updated, stay tuned!）

[b][About the Arcane mode][/b]
After this full version update, the new game mode - Arcane mode is available!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/75c58c18e5b1a641cd58dd4cbc9d1b4d9a5dbc15.png[/img]
[b][Skill Enhancement][/b]
In Arcane mode, all skills can be enhanced through [Embed], and some skills will have exclusive ultimate effects!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/54807f21380f10d801a3096a41ce3db36171ea50.png[/img]
[b][Crossroad Events][/b]
When entering a level, there is a chance to encounter [crossroads], leading to different areas and obtaining more treasures!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/0a6f581c0ef9192abd92572fd1d147ec28b336d6.png[/img]
[b][Random Talents][/b]
In Arcane mode, the character's talent tree disappears, replaced by random talent cards, allowing for more powerful builds!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/7306c1b3d57a8b3add52fc5bd73c5aad982d3910.png[/img]

notes.title: Update roadmap is out now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The update roadmap for Darkchaser: Battletide is out! It shows the major updates we've implemented during EA and our plans for the near future. We're also gearing up for the official release, so make sure to follow us on social media and join our community to get the latest game news!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/aa1c5d596b0739396410f2eab47bb54738e2b812.png[/img]

Here's what we've done and what's coming up:

Implemented:

Character Talent Update: We've revamped and adjusted character talents to enhance strategic depth and playability.
Controller Support & Optimization: The game now fully supports controllers and has been optimized for a smooth experience.
Multilingual Support: We've added support for more languages, so more players can enjoy the game in their native tongue.
New PVP Mode: A brand new PVP mode is live, come and challenge other players!

Coming Soon:

New Boss Skills: We're adding more skills to bosses for extra fun challenges!
Building Update: New building features are in the works, offering more strategic options.
Planned Content: We're cooking up some new stuff, so stay tuned.

The full version of Darkchaser: Battletide is coming soon, with more exciting content waiting for you! We'll keep listening to player feedback and continue to improve the game experience. Thanks for all your support and enthusiasm!

notes.title: Who says only monsters can build an army?
notes.notes:
《Darkchaser:Battletide is a survivors-like game where players become adventurers stepping into a world ravaged by monsters. In this world full of danger and unknown challenges, adventurers must cleverly use various skills and relics to arm themselves, battling against endless enemies, and grow stronger through layers of challenges!

This time, we're introducing a major gameplay style, Summoning. Facing the relentless monster tide, summon powerful allies to fight by your side and survive the frenzied onslaught!

The game's Steam page is now live, with early access starting on May 9th. You can add Darkchaser:Battletide to your wishlist now!

The archer's precise arrows, the mage's frost projectiles, the giant bear's taunting roar... Each summon has its own abilities and characteristics, who will be the star of this battle tide feast? The summoning party is about to get heated!

[b]Summoning Encyclopedia[/b]

[b]Frost Mage[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/3dda2afee82422bb53eb84ea68c0d8da47366ced.png[/img]
With the ghostly fireworks, summoned is a mage wielding the power of frost. Not only can he dish out AOE spells, but he can also freeze enemies solid, stopping monsters in their tracks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/4ebb3c32bbcd5cac8f2dceeecf9b53338395e57e.png[/img]

[b]Golem Warrior[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/71eebd6f37ab842b87330d3caeed62d4b3594c9a.png[/img]
Wielding a battle axe, this fearless warrior boasts massive damage output. With his heavy axe, the nightmare for monsters begins, as he carves a bloody path with unmatched vigor!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/4ca147426585746cfe8b70b3b84e88f54d383a03.png[/img]

[b]Giant Bear[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/4becfb1e59d4fc90a9efad4a726cc764bb8a0b49.png[/img]
The giant bear has a ton of health and can taunt monsters to take damage for the team. Its roar seems to scatter the dark clouds filled with monsters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/6e478279c71b85d795d45300cb9bfe118428030d.png[/img]

[b]Master Archer[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/a3140e25840b56ad08337ad5719e7e201f220742.png[/img]
The Master Archer, with his deadly accuracy, can strike monsters from a far, his arrows laced with poison draining their life before they even realize...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/0c6231a8a85f2020541f123c0fc8cb948338421b.png[/img]

[b]Wild Wolf[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/61d0591bae45c02af12254f7c3b48cfafcaa57f1.png[/img]
The wild wolf pack is a terrifying force on the battlefield. As their numbers grow, so does their combat strength. These aggressive wolves can even heal themselves by attacking enemies, making them unstoppable in conquering monsters!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/c44005ce71bb78b22271825b3f3bd09635d5923c.png[/img]

[b]Magic Bee[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/bf73f8cd394b490000c574a01ad103bdd06f9fd4.png[/img]
Magic Bees might not pack a powerful punch or have a ton of HP, but like hardworking bees, they bring a unique vibe to the battlefield. Buzzing through enemy lines, their attacks might not be the strongest, but they have a chance to drop precious Recovery Jade for players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/341bcd8e94109b163b002678ad691825a6eab118.png[/img]

[b]Key Artifacts of Summoning[/b]

[b]Soulfire War Drums[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/8524708dee8eb0430809598fe4b644e5383d7187.png[/img]
Pumps up your summons, giving them a massive power boost. But it also burns their souls, making them take more DMG.

[b]Soul Lantern[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/4ae2ed33de2e6fff2087c619c85183f9293ae5ef.png[/img]
Who says it's just a monster army out here? The Soul Lantern lets you summon more creatures, building a massive summon army to face off against the monster hordes!

[b]Cursed Music Box[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/fa1d5276d22a10345d1b216ba62353301bf2a667.png[/img]
The curse takes from the life of your summons but lets them fulfill their purpose better. The Cursed Music Box makes your summons explode at the end of their mission, dealing a fatal blow to the monsters.

The magic surge is fierce, but going solo isn't your only option. On the endless battlefield, you can strategize and mix various summons with artifact buffs to create an unbeatable summon army to clash with the monsters!

notes.title: Unveiling the secrets of close combat in Darkchaser: Battletide
notes.notes:
Darkchaser: Battletideis a survivors-like game where you step into a world overrun by monsters as a brave hero. In this world full of dangers and unknown challenges, you need to cleverly use various skills and relics to arm yourself, battle against endless enemies, and grow stronger through layers of challenges!

This time, we're introducing the close combat school - Martial Skill build. Facing the monster army, grip your blade tightly and shred the enemies with various Martial Skills.

The game's Steam page is now live, with early access starting on May 9th. Interested buddies can add Darkchaser: Battletide to their wishlist now!

[b]Martial Skill compendium[/b]
[b][Infinite Growth][/b]
Many Martial Skills come with powerful growth attributes. As you battle through, you'll refine your techniques, making your Martial Skills even mightier. That's the path of a true warrior.

·Sword Slash
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/a2b0038239ac42e5f1c4b6a18438c7469ac110ad.png[/img]
Each time you defeat enemies with this Martial Skill, you gain extra HP. Shield yourself with courage, charge ahead, and withstand enemy attacks with your ever-growing health!

·Rampage Assault
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/dd562c794f2a332dbca154e9fd392ef8941b9c4d.png[/img]
Each time you defeat enemies with this Martial Skill, you gain extra Attack Speed. In the world of martial arts, speed is unbeatable. Crush your enemies with increasingly swift strikes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/50a86cfe59c7291819e5637645f34975d16d1ad7.png[/img]

·Inspiring Strike
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/c85829fcdcc1ba100bf6efbbe19b54d6389d5ca9.png[/img]
Each time you defeat enemies with this Martial Skill, you gain extra DMG bonus. Turn the blood of your foes into nourishment for your blade. The only thing on your mind should be how to rack up more kills in the heat of battle!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/98ae67d9f8b0bc9187c3c8f25ed78a884661613a.png[/img]

[b][Physical][/b]
To survive up-close combat, besides growth-type Martial Skills, you gotta master some straightforward and brutal techniques.

Use this Martial Skill to turn your sword energy into a fierce whirlwind, hitting enemies from a distance. Besides its range advantage, the whirlwind also offers solid crowd control.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/98ae67d9f8b0bc9187c3c8f25ed78a884661613a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/e99605de92da6ea72e643669c68562e20d1b6793.png[/img]

Increases Crystal drops. You'll get ahead in resources, have a blast shopping for more relics and skill boosts.

notes.title: Darkchaser: Battletide Genre Introduction
notes.notes:
Darkchaser: Battletide is a Rogue-like game where players play as heroes entering a world ravaged by monsters, arming themselves with various skills and relics to engage in fierce battles against countless enemies, becoming stronger through challenges!

In the game, various skills and relics give rise to multiple genre choices, each with its unique gameplay and strategy. Here are some of the main genres in the game:

[b]1. Summon Genre[/b]
The summon genre focuses on "team cooperation", with summons like the Frost Mage, Brave Warrior, Sharpshooter, and Giant Bear. Players can enhance their summons by upgrading their levels and pairing them with aura relics to create their own "summoning legion" to crush waves of enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/db636a76a2d647af8a21ebd6ec20ab86168f19ac.png[/img]

[b]2. Elemental Genre[/b]
The elemental genre is mainly divided into fire, ice, and poison elements. Players can choose skills of different elements to attack enemies and equip relics with different elemental bonuses to cause multi-elemental damage. This genre requires players to be familiar with various elemental skills and relics to maximize their power in battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/f18f0f7f65efb14441b480418d040b18cf12626e.png[/img]

[b]3. Melee Genre[/b]
The melee genre emphasizes "close combat" fighting, with representative skills like Combat - Bone Crusher, Agile - Sword Wave, Martial Arts - Double Strike, and Blade of Absorption. This genre requires players to have the ability to seize the moment and react quickly to defeat encircling enemies in the shortest time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/0ece3322c19555f5d81a99edd39d4ce58dada36c.png[/img]

[b]4. Missile Genre[/b]
The missile genre focuses on long-range attacks, allowing players to choose missile skills with characteristics like penetration, knockback, and rebound to defeat enemies before they get close. This genre requires players to have skilled kiting abilities to maintain an advantage in battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/cc88ed8a5280b2647d7ad903e5c54b09b2f37229.png[/img]

These are some of the main genres in Darkchaser: Battletide, each with its unique gameplay and strategy. Players can choose the genre that suits their preferences to enjoy different fun. We also encourage players to continuously try new genres and combinations in the game to discover more possibilities and fun!

notes.title: Darkchaser: Battletide Developer Log 01:
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are We are the development team of Darkchaser: Battletide, and we are thrilled to share with you our first game, Darkchaser: Battletide.

Survivors-like,a game genre that has suddenly become popular in the last two years, features simple and straightforward gameplay, low production difficulty, but is quite interesting to play. For a small indie studio like us, choosing this type of game as our first project is quite reasonable.

In this developer log, we want to talk about the journey of creating Darkchaser: Battletide and how we view the survivors-like genre.

About half a year ago, when we were thinking about the design pillars of the game, we came across a question: "Besides bullet shooting, what else can we add to a survivors-like game?"

With this question in mind, in the early stages of game creation, we decided to leave more space for creativity in the game system, anticipating the addition of more different genres and constructions later on, making the gameplay not limited to bullets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/c2934828304a3ddb6fa35905cdb66f5bee9abbf1.png[/img]
[i](and bugs LOL)[/i]

When the first internal demo of the game was released in last Novemberr, the space  deliberately left by us only continuously increased the difficulty of fixing bugs (a bitter laugh). But later, as the summoning, building, and other skill systems were supplemented, we increasingly felt that these blanks were meaningful. At least they really allowed us to break free from the constraints of bullet shooting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967144/f49eff10c708f9cff63435bd05b27bc183b5bf16.png[/img]
[i](when there's no limit on the number of buildings.)[/i]

Besides, we have also done many other things, such as various genres, character talent trees, etc., all of which will be unveiled in subsequent developer logs!

The game is about to meet everyone in Early Access, and of course, we are also prepared to continue developing and providing updates after EA launch. After the store page opens, we expect a long time to perfect the game, looking forward to seeing more feedback and suggestions from you in the future. In subsequent developer logs, we will also timely sync the current development progress and answer your questions.

The game's Steam store page is now online, hurry up and add it to your wishlist. EA is expected to launch next month, please don't miss it!
